verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents a fast quickstart (a browser bot in under 5 minutes), and its dev runner terminates telephony WebSockets. A documented command (`python bot.py -t twilio -x ...ngrok.io`) connects the same bot to carriers such as Twilio, Telnyx and Plivo. However, the phone number must come from an external carrier, local testing needs an ngrok tunnel, and the documented quickstart is browser-based rather than phone-based, so the one-hour phone path is unproven. Missing for 10: first-party phone number provisioning, a documented phone-call quickstart with time-to-first-call, and hands-on corroboration of a live call within an hour.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a working phone voice agent — prompt, voice, and phone number — and take my first live call within an hour

citations.quote: Build and run your first Pipecat voice AI bot in under 5 minutes: a simple conversational agent you can talk to in a browser.
